name: Snowy RPG {☀FLOOR 2 PASSAGE}
desc:
This RPG is inspired by classics like Tibia RPG, Dungeon ni Deai, Arifureta, Overlord, and Solo Leveling. Players can enjoy an infinite leveling system with no cap, offering endless progression and challenges.

Leveling Mechanics:

❤Gain +50 HP for every level *HP SCALLING
⚔Gain +1 Damage for every level *DMG SCALLING
👟Receive +1 Speed every 100 levels. *SPEED SCALLING
